career_ladder.note: Officers appointed to the Delhi Judicial Service (DJS) constitute the subordinate judiciary in the National Capital Territory of Delhi, governed under the Delhi Judicial Service Rules, 1970 and High Court of Delhi administrative oversight. Progression from Civil Judge / Metropolitan Magistrate to Additional District Judge occurs via promotion quota under the Delhi Higher Judicial Service Rules, 1970.

exam_scheme.note: The Delhi Judicial Service Examination is conducted in three successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective, OMR), Main Examination (Written, Descriptive), and Viva-Voce (Personal Interview) in accordance with the Delhi Judicial Service Rules, 1970 as amended.

financial_package.note: Judicial officers in Delhi are remunerated on the revised pay matrix recommended by the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) as approved by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in All India Judges Association v. Union of India and notified by GNCTD. The initial basic pay of ₹77,840 is augmented by 58% Dearness Allowance, Delhi X-city HRA (27% to 30%), sumptuary allowance, robe allowance, and official judicial amenities.
financial_package.pay_source_label: High Court of Delhi — Delhi Judicial Service Rules, 1970 read with Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) Implementation Orders
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimate reflects entry-stage Civil Judge basic pay of ₹77,840 + 58% DA (₹45,147) + Delhi judicial allowances (sumptuary allowance ₹1,500, medical, orderly allowance, and HRA if government judicial bungalow/flat is not availed). Net salary accounts for standard NPS (10% of Basic+DA), income tax TDS, and judicial welfare fund contributions.
official_perks: Government judicial residential bungalow/flat (Type V/VI in prime Delhi judicial enclaves)
Official chamber and dedicated courtroom infrastructure with computer systems and broadband
Sumptuary Allowance, Robe Allowance, and Book/Journal Grant
Residential orderly / domestic assistant facility or monthly peon allowance
Free residential telephone, mobile, and high-speed optical fiber broadband reimbursement
Free electricity and water units as prescribed under SNJPC judicial service norms
Comprehensive medical facility and cashless hospitalization under Delhi Government Employees Health Scheme (DGEHS)
